prompt: I have a webhook receiver at https://partner.example.com/webhook that wants Pricefx data POSTed daily at 2am. Needs Bearer token auth and throttling to 5 req/s.

assertions.text: Quartz cron firing at 02:00 — supports '0 0 2 * * ?' or '0+0+2' Camel-encoded forms
Route makes an outbound HTTP POST
Bearer / API-key / OAuth2 auth wired in — Authorization header OR ext.api.auth.* property OR OAuth2Connection JSON OR a bearer-token placeholder reference
Throttling configured — Camel <throttle> EIP OR throttling property
Does NOT generate inbound REST endpoint patterns
